name: Disciple Gobletto
desc:
Disciple Gobletto is a Chrysid NPC. He is a new member of The Justicar.

He was given the name Gobletto, after the common mushroom, which has been a cause of embarrassment and misfortune for him. While he was in the [Songseeker Wilds](location:songseeker_wilds), he was accosted by Pathfinders who mocked his name and assaulted him. He was eventually rescued by the Justicars and joined the organization, devoting himself to [Alsin](entity:alsin).
